heading: SGB Redemption: ₹1 Lakh Becomes ₹3.09 Lakh for Early Investors
tldr: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) Series 2020-21 I investors have seen their initial investment grow significantly upon maturity.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) fixed the redemption price for this series at ₹14,159 per gram.
An investment of ₹1 lakh made in this series has matured to approximately ₹3.09 lakh, including interest.
This translates to an impressive return of nearly 209% over the 8-year investment period.
SGBs offer a unique blend of gold price appreciation, assured interest, and tax benefits on maturity.
caption:
Imagine turning ₹1 lakh into ₹3.09 lakh! That's what happened for some early investors in Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs). This article shows how a government-backed gold scheme helped people grow their money significantly, offering both gold value growth and extra interest.
